name: Tree Blight

source.note: Curse of Strahd appendix block (2016) in the 2024 layout. Entered from knowledge, not yet checked against the book. The number of attacks in its Multiattack especially needs the book. A root's hit deals no damage of its own here (0) and grabs; the crushing damage each turn, cutting a root, and the Bite (a Bonus Action against a creature it holds) are text only. Wintersplinter on Yester Hill can use this block under its own name.

languages: understands Common and Druidic but can't speak

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.summary: Indistinguishable from a dead tree while it stays still.

traits.name: Siege Monster
traits.summary: Deals double damage to objects and structures.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.summary: Makes two Branch attacks and two Grasping Root attacks.

actions.name: Branch
actions.summary: A sweeping branch with 15 ft reach.

actions.name: Grasping Root
actions.summary: Seizes a creature it isn't already holding (escape DC 15); the held creature is crushed each turn.
actions.text: The held creature takes 9 (1d6 + 6) Bludgeoning damage at the start of each of its turns. A root has AC 15; 6 or more Slashing damage in one hit cuts it and ends that grapple without hurting the blight.

bonus_actions.name: Bite
bonus_actions.summary: Bonus Action: bites a creature it holds with a root.

summary: A dead-looking tree that walks: long branches batter, roots grab and crush, and its maw bites anyone it holds.
